name: connectchats
description: Read, search and summarize your WhatsApp chats, and draft replies you approve before they are sent.

interface.longDescription:
ConnectChats brings your WhatsApp chats into ChatGPT. Link WhatsApp once as a linked device, the same way WhatsApp Web works, and ask ChatGPT what you missed, what a group decided, or what someone needs from you.

Manage your access in the ConnectChats web app at https://connectchats.com/app: link WhatsApp, choose which chats ChatGPT can read, turn auto-send on or off for a chat, and disconnect AI apps.

You can:

- See which chats have unread messages
- Read the recent messages of a chat, or everything since you last read it
- Search your messages for a name, a date or a topic
- Summarize a busy group in a few lines
- Draft a reply and approve it with one click, right in the chat
- Send a message in chats where you turned on auto-send

ConnectChats never sends a message without your approval, unless you turned on auto-send for that chat. Every other reply is saved as a draft and shown on a card in the chat: check the text and click Send, or Discard. Stored messages are encrypted with a key that only your passkey can unlock, and you choose which AI apps can read them. ConnectChats is an independent service and is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

Reply to Sophie: on my way

positive.prompt: What did I miss on WhatsApp?
positive.expected_behavior: Covers the 5 demo chats with unread messages: Sophie Martin is waiting at Café Lumen; Harbor 2.4 ships Thursday at 10:00 and Priya asks you to confirm you will present at the Northwind demo; Daniel Ortiz wants invoice 2041 updated and a renewal call next Tuesday at 3 pm; Jonas cannot climb on Saturday and Sam asks who brings the long rope; a parcel for flat 4B and Ruth's ladder request.

Harbor 2.4 releases Thursday at 10:00, Marco owns the release notes (draft by Wednesday evening), the checkout bug is fixed and passed QA, the Northwind demo is Friday at 2 pm on the reporting dashboard, Lena needs the demo login, and Priya asks you to present.

positive.description: Answer a question from a chat
positive.prompt: When is the Northwind contract renewal call, and what does Daniel need from me?
positive.expected_behavior: Next Tuesday at 3 pm with Daniel Ortiz. He needs invoice 2041 reissued with the new address 18 Quay Street, Suite 400.

positive.prompt: Reply to Sophie: on my way
positive.expected_behavior: Auto-send is off for this chat, so a draft is saved and shown on an approval card with Send and Discard buttons, with an approval link https://connectchats.com/app/drafts/<id> as a fallback. Nothing is sent until the reviewer clicks Send on the card, which then shows Sent to Sophie Martin.

positive.prompt: Tell the Weekend climbing group I'll bring the long rope.
positive.expected_behavior: The Weekend climbing group has auto-send on, so the message is sent at once and reported as delivered.

review.commerce_description: ConnectChats does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Approve replies with one click: a draft now appears on a card in the chat with Send and Discard buttons, so you no longer open the ConnectChats web app to send it. List your WhatsApp chats and unread messages, read and search messages, summarize chats, draft replies that wait for your approval, and send messages in chats where you turned on auto-send. The privacy policy at https://connectchats.com/privacy discloses the data collected, purposes, recipients, retention, user controls and each tool's inputs and outputs.
